title: Intelligence Brief
subtitle: archify holds GitHub Trending #2 at +3,991 stars/d, OpenMAIC debuts at GitHub #1 : AI teachers and cla, scientific-agent-skills hits GitHub #3 with 163 pa

heroStat.label: Mistral's open-weight Voxtral TTS beat ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 in blind listening tests

insights.text: archify holds GitHub Trending #2 at +3,991 stars/day (39,583 total), accelerating rather than cooling on its second tracked day since yesterday's +3,722/day debut — a diagram-generation agent skill, not a framework.

OpenMAIC debuts at GitHub #1 (+2,824/day, 27,772 total): AI teachers and classmates that speak and hold real-time discussion in an auto-generated interactive classroom, built on LangGraph multi-agent orchestration.

scientific-agent-skills hits GitHub #3 (+1,980/day, 40,931 total) with 163 packaged skills for scientific research — but its headline claim of 190,000+ scientist users has zero independent verification anywhere in the repo.

Apple moved its Mac Mini and Mac Studio relaunch earlier than the usual October/November window because enterprise AI-workload demand caught the company off guard, with some configurations unavailable for months.
The new Mac Mini ships Apple's first dual Neural Engine (two 16-core engines), and multiple Mac Studio units can now cluster into one system to run larger local AI models.

Mistral's Voxtral TTS is a 3.4B-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model running on 3GB RAM at 90ms first-audio latency, beating ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 in 62.8% of blind preference tests and 69.9% on voice customization.

ChatGPT (#6, 4.8 stars) and Google Gemini (#7, 4.7 stars) both appear in today's Play Store top-30 together, breaking yesterday's two-day streak of neither AI-chat app being visible; Claude remains absent.

p-e-w/heretic, an automated model-uncensoring tool, continues trending at +537/day (29,749 total) alongside Hugging Face's own uncensored Qwen3.8-27B forks — de-alignment stays a same-week commodity step after every major open-weight release.

takeaway.text: The skill-not-framework distribution pattern keeps compounding (archify's second accelerating day) while the two vendors selling proprietary voice quality (ElevenLabs, Wispr) just got an open-weight competitor that beats one of them in blind tests.
